title.zh: 复古游戏：能玩，还要玩得舒服

category.zh: 浏览器游戏 · 交互体验

summary.zh: 从一个 HTML 小游戏，迭代到速度、音效、全屏和 HUD 的反复打磨。
summary.en: A single-file game evolves through feedback on pacing, sound, fullscreen scaling, and the HUD.

why.zh: 目标一眼能懂；“代码已经改了”和“用户实际看到修复了”之间的差距，也很直观。
why.en: An immediately understandable goal exposes the gap between a code change and a fix the user can actually see.

artifact.adaptations: Added a restrictive preview CSP. Fitness mockup only: compiled original Tailwind theme locally, localized icon fonts and avatar, and removed external font loading. No task logic repaired.

visualNote.zh: 截图来自历史消息 #63 的完整 HTML 写入，#64 确认写入成功。本地已验证可启动；不代表全屏、音效等要求已全部验收。
visualNote.en: Captured from the complete HTML write in historical message #63, confirmed in #64. Startup was checked locally; full acceptance of fullscreen, sound, and other requirements is not established.

zh: 游戏能启动、操作、计分并进入结束状态
全屏时画面与 HUD 一起缩放，且不裁切
新增音效和速度调整后，原有交互仍可用
en: Startup, controls, scoring, and end states
Scale the game and HUD together without clipping
Preserve interaction while changing sound and speed

takeaway.zh: 后续用户多次报告全屏仍未放大、HUD 被裁切。这个案例展示反复反馈，不把历史写入成功等同于修复成功。
takeaway.en: Later user messages repeatedly report unchanged fullscreen size and clipped HUD text. A successful file write is not treated as proof of a successful fix.

turns.original: Schreibe ein komplettes Space-Invaders-Spiel in einer einzigen HTML-Datei (mit integriertem JavaScript und CSS, HTML5 Canvas).

translation.zh: 用单个 HTML 文件制作完整的 Space Invaders 游戏，内嵌 JavaScript、CSS 和 Canvas。
translation.en: Build a complete Space Invaders game in one HTML file with embedded JavaScript, CSS, and Canvas.

focus.zh: 交付目标从一开始就包括可玩性。
focus.en: The initial deliverable must be playable.

turns.original: Mach das Spielgeschehen etwas langsamer und flüssiger (Geschwindigkeit der Aliens und Schüsse drosseln).

translation.zh: 让游戏更慢、更流畅。同一条消息还要求用 Web Audio 合成音效，并修复全屏退出问题。
translation.en: Slow down the action and make it smoother. The same message also requests synthesized Web Audio effects and a fix for exiting fullscreen.

focus.zh: 同一轮反馈同时涉及体验与功能。
focus.en: One round of feedback spans experience and functionality.

turns.original: Aber das grösste Problem: der Bildschirm bleibt immer gleich groß, egal ob Vollbild oder nicht, das ist natürlich nicht Sinn der Sache.

title.zh: 全屏了，画面却没有变大

translation.zh: 最大的问题是，不论是否全屏，游戏画面始终一样大。
translation.en: The biggest problem is that the game remains the same size, whether fullscreen is enabled or not.

focus.zh: 检查实际显示效果，而不是只检查全屏 API。
focus.en: Inspect the visible result, not only the fullscreen API.

turns.original: Die HUD-Schrift oben wird im normalen Modus und im Vollbild abgeschnitten und das Spielfeld skaliert nicht korrekt.

title.zh: 反馈进一步定位到 HUD 与容器
title.en: Narrow the issue to HUD and container

translation.zh: 普通模式和全屏模式都会裁切顶部 HUD，游戏区域缩放也不正确。用户进一步指定共同容器和等比缩放。
translation.en: The HUD is clipped in both modes and the playfield scales incorrectly. The user then specifies a shared container and proportional scaling.

focus.zh: 后续约束更具体，但早期要求仍要保留。
focus.en: New constraints become more precise while earlier requirements still apply.

source.note: Source indices identify historical messages, not benchmark evaluation rounds. Translations and display summaries are editorial.
